course.title: Legal Basis of Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Consider yourself an urban planner employed by a real estate firm. A layout plan (12) has to be created for a private housing project. Describe in detail what must be in the layout plan for the project to be approved by the concerned authority.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
